column1: # Example: AP-MS interactors of eight SPA-tagged E. coli DNA replication proteins (DnaA, DnaB, DnaG, DiaA, Hda, HolD, NrdB, SeqA; chromosomal tags in K-12 MG1655) during fast exponential growth in LB; one row per protein, preys pooled across baits.

# Source: Morcinek-Orłowska J, Walter B, Forquet R, et al. (2023) Interaction networks of Escherichia coli replication proteins under different bacterial growth conditions. Sci Data 10(1):788. https://doi.org/10.1038/s41597-023-02710-1
# Source file: Figshare "Quantitative data processing, 20230829" (https://doi.org/10.6084/m9.figshare.24050925.v1), the eight <Bait>_quantitative.xlsx files, sheet "LB log"; raw data PRIDE PXD030113

# Cutoff: the paper's quantitative strategy (log2 enrichment >= 1.5 and BH-adjusted z-score p <= 0.01 against both an untagged and a SPA-tagged Venus control, present in all three replicates; preys absent from one control and significant against the other, or absent from both controls, are also kept, as in the published files); 229 bait/prey rows across the 8 sheets, 150 unique proteins; value = highest "Log2 enrichment with ctr2" across baits, baits = baits that pulled the prey down
